_about: Hand corrections to single Wikidata events, applied by tools/build_events.py. Only for cases where the Wikidata date is plainly a slip or leaves out a well-known second date. Each has a source and a note that the app shows with the event.

overrides.note: Wikidata dates this 31 March 1864; the convention was signed on 31 March 1854.
Issued in preliminary form on 22 September 1862 (the Wikidata date); the final proclamation took effect on 1 January 1863.
Wikidata gives only February 1917, when the revolt was finally suppressed; it began in July 1916.
